stem: Which graph best represents the solution set of y > 3x - 4?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph with solid line y = 3x - 4 shading to the right of the line

options.label: B
options.text: Graph with solid line y = 3x - 4 shading to the left of the line

options.label: C
options.text: Graph with dashed line y = 3x - 4 shading to the right of the line

options.label: D
options.text: Graph with dashed line y = 3x - 4 shading to the left of the line

visual_elements: Four graphs showing lines and shaded regions labeled A, B, C, D
notes: Shading and line type are used to distinguish the inequality solution sets. The correct graph must have a dashed line (because of >, not ≥) and shading above/right of the line.
